name: Nneka Sjostrom-Kwarteng
role: Covert entry and social penetration specialist — infiltrator
location: The Circuit — neon-lit entertainment and vice district
description:
Nneka Sjostrom-Kwarteng is compact and densely muscled, built low to the ground like something designed to survive impacts. At 32, scars map his face like a transit diagram of bad decisions and worse luck. The chrome is visible — cyberears with directional microphones and sound dampening — can hear whispers a — and he makes no effort to hide it.

He arrived in Meridian 88 six years ago with nothing but chrome and debts, and has been working off both ever since. He works as a infiltrator out of The Circuit, taking contracts that match his skills and his risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

Everyone who's worked with Nneka Sjostrom-Kwarteng agrees on two things: he is worth the fee, and he is terrible company at dinner.

core_fears: Their past catching up — debts, enemies, broken promises
That the work they do makes the city worse, not better
That their reputation is built on luck, not skill, and the luck is finite
core_desires: To prove everyone who dismissed them catastrophically wrong
The perfect run — one job so clean it becomes legend
Freedom from augmentation debt — the interest compounds like a tumor
coping_mechanisms: Planning — responds to chaos by making detailed contingency plans for everything
Denial — nothing is wrong, everything is fine, they are fine, shut up
Isolates — retreats into their space when overwhelmed, emerges only for work
blind_spots: Mistakes pattern recognition for wisdom — sees connections that aren't there
Cannot accept help without interpreting it as leverage
Cannot distinguish between caution and cowardice in themselves or others
psychology.secret: Nneka Sjostrom-Kwarteng has been doubling fees to clients and pocketing the difference. The fixer who handles their contracts doesn't know. Yet.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Old-fashioned formal diction — sounds like they learned to speak from pre-collapse recordings.
speech_patterns.cadence: Low and even — the vocal equivalent of still water.
verbal_tics: Refers to killing as 'solving' — clinical detachment as coping mechanism
Ends statements with 'yeah?' — not a question, a dare
example_lines: "The best disguise is being exactly who they expect to see."
"I was in the building for six hours before anyone realized I didn't work there."
"Security is a story people tell themselves. I'm the plot twist."

story_hooks: A Tier 4 executive offers Nneka Sjostrom-Kwarteng a permanent position — the pay is obscene and the strings are invisible until they tighten
Nneka Sjostrom-Kwarteng intercepts intelligence about a threat to their district and must decide between profit and protection
A crew member from Nneka Sjostrom-Kwarteng's past shows up in Meridian 88, carrying old grievances and new chrome
narrative_function: Nneka Sjostrom-Kwarteng is a pressure point — the kind of character whose choices ripple outward. When he makes a decision, other people's lives change. That weight is the engine of his stories.
augmentations: Cyberears with directional microphones and sound dampening — can hear whispers at 50 meters. Subdermal weapon mount — pop-out blade in each forearm
daily_life: Between contracts, maintains a cover identity — mundane work, mundane hours, mundane neighbors. The transition from civilian to runner and back requires a conscious effort that gets easier with practice and more disturbing with self-awareness.

strengths: mechanical aptitude — can repair or modify almost anything
social chameleon — adapts to any environment
weaknesses: risk-averse to the point of missed opportunities
old injury that flares under specific conditions
poor impulse control in specific triggers

decision_rules: Will not take contracts against children or families — the line is hard and non-negotiable
Maintains a personal blacklist of clients who've burned runners — checks it religiously
Will not betray a client who paid in full, regardless of better offers
Always verifies target identity independently before lethal contracts
escalation_ladder: 2. Evade — avoid the problem entirely if possible
3. Misdirect — create a distraction, redirect attention
4. Disable — targeted takedowns, quiet and efficient
5. Eliminate — when silence is no longer an option
6. Vanish — disappear completely, burn identity if necessary

interpersonal_modes.employers: Carefully managed deference that conceals a thorough assessment of their vulnerabilities.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Competitive but reliable. Will challenge decisions but never abandon the team.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Dismissive unless they demonstrate usefulness or threat potential. Time is a resource.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Predatory focus. Threats are problems, and problems have solutions. The solution is usually kinetic.

stress_responses.low: Heightened awareness, sharper focus. Low stress is fuel.
stress_responses.medium: Becomes curt and demanding. Efficiency overrides courtesy.
stress_responses.high: Controlled aggression. The training takes over. Emotions are packed into a box for later.
stress_responses.critical: Berserker clarity. Everything becomes simple: survive. Deal with the rest later. The simplicity is almost peaceful.

contradictions: Preaches independence but is desperate for approval from people they respect
Claims not to care about reputation but monitors what people say about them obsessively
Despises corporate culture but has unconsciously adopted its efficiency metrics and self-optimization language
habits: Maintains a dead drop with emergency supplies in three separate districts
Wears the same item of clothing for luck — a scarf, a glove, a specific pair of boots
Never drinks anything they didn't see poured or open themselves
Eats the same meal before every job — superstition masquerading as preference
breaking_points: Discovering their employer deliberately sent them into a death trap
Betrayal by the one person they actually trust — the single point of failure in their emotional architecture
